name: Block Sudo Commands
description: Blocks sudo commands unless explicitly allowed, preventing unintended privilege escalation
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Block sudo commands
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
ALLOW_FILE="$HOME/.claude/sudo-allowlist.txt"
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\|)\s*sudo\s'; then
  # Check allowlist
  if [[ -f "$ALLOW_FILE" ]]; then
    SUDO_CMD=$(echo "$COMMAND" | grep -oE 'sudo\s+\S+')
    if grep -qF "$SUDO_CMD" "$ALLOW_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
      exit 0
    fi
  fi
  echo "BLOCKED: sudo commands are not allowed. Add to ~/.claude/sudo-allowlist.txt to permit specific commands."
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
